_comment: Product catalog + shopify_inventory. product_class drives the policy engine: HIGH_VALUE always requires human approval. final_sale blocks returns and exchanges entirely.

products.title: Atlas Tower Case
products.description: Steel and tempered-glass chassis with a mesh front, three 120mm intake fans included and a vertical GPU mount. The Mid Tower clears 330mm cards and 165mm coolers; the Full Tower clears 400mm and 185mm.

products.title: Frostline AIO Liquid Cooler
products.description: Closed-loop liquid cooler with a copper cold plate, a low-noise pump and pre-applied thermal compound. Ships with AM5 and LGA1700 brackets in the box.

products.title: Airflow 120mm Fan, 3-pack
products.description: Fluid-dynamic bearing fans, 1600 RPM, PWM controlled, rubber-mounted corners. Daisy-chain cables included.

products.title: Foundry B850 Motherboard
products.description: AM5 socket, DDR5 up to 8000 MT/s, PCIe 5.0 x16, two M.2 slots with heatsinks, 2.5G LAN. Check the form factor against your case before ordering — an ATX board does not fit a Mini-ITX chassis.

products.title: Kinetic DDR5-6000 32GB Kit
products.description: Matched 2x16GB kit, CL30, EXPO and XMP profiles on board, low-profile aluminium heatspreader that clears most air coolers. DDR5 only — it will not post in a DDR4 board.

variants._simulate: PERMANENT_OUT_OF_STOCK — target of the ORD-1007 exchange. No restock date, so the exchange must fall back to a refund with shipping waived (POL-EXC-001).

products.title: Braided PSU Cable Extension Kit
products.description: Individually sleeved 24-pin, EPS and PCIe extensions with combs. Extensions only — they do not replace the cables that came with the power supply.

products.title: Cryo-X Thermal Compound, 5g
products.description: Non-conductive, non-capacitive paste rated to 12.5 W/mK. Includes a spreader and two cleaning wipes.

products.title: Vantage DDR4-3200 16GB Kit
products.description: Matched 2x8GB kit, CL16. End-of-life platform clearance — final sale, no returns or exchanges.

products.title: Radiant RX-800 16GB Graphics Card
products.description: Triple-fan 16GB card, 2.8 slots, 332mm long, 12V-2x6 power connector. Measure your case clearance before ordering; a 750W supply is the practical minimum.

products.title: Titan 32-Core Workstation CPU
products.description: 32 cores, 64 threads, 5.4 GHz boost, 128 PCIe lanes, 350W TDP. Sold without a cooler — a 280mm liquid cooler or better is required.
